layouts.name: Grand Prix — 5.183 km
layouts.description: Operator-identified 2022 extended main course: the complete northern sector and southern extension replace the earlier unnamed candidate and its northern shortcut. Main way 491591561 indices 139 and 160 join extension 1314505677 by exact shared node IDs; the old southern return between these nodes is excluded. Northern crossover 729149906, short infield bypasses, karting, rallycross, motocross, drifting and pits are excluded. Geometry remains draft, and exact racing-line placement requires review. Start/finish GPS is unavailable for these configurations and is not inferred from their filename or circuit drawings.

The current OSM centerline measures 4093.4 m; the 7.4 m difference remains explicit. This is an independently identified public configuration; a generic archive filename does not establish which configuration it represents. Geometry remains draft, and exact racing-line placement requires review. Start/finish GPS is unavailable for these configurations and is not inferred from their filename or circuit drawings.
